During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the '''Clone Captain''' was a specialized [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] breed which was bred on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] as battlefield officers and special mission operatives.

==Role==
[[File:RexPhase2Badass-SWE.png|thumb|left|250px|[[Rex/Legends|Rex]], Captain of the 501st Legion, in his customized Phase II armor]]
At the start of the war, clone trooper captains were recognized by their unique red markings on their helmets and torso armor, but as the war progressed, clone trooper armor became more customized, and red markings no longer signified the rank of captain. Clone trooper [[Captain/Legends|captains]] were assigned to lead [[Company/Legends|companies]] of 144 standard clone troopers, which were divided into four separate platoons. Each platoon was commanded by a [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|clone trooper lieutenant]] who would report directly to their respective captains. These clones were often equipped with a [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifle]] and a line of [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]], although as the war progressed a number of clone captains would use specialized weaponry which suited their respective combat styles. Trained in both [[Squad/Legends|squad]]- and company-level tactics, as well as to handle the [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|74-Z speeder bike]], clone trooper captains were diverse leaders.

==History==
Clone trooper captains first appeared during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]] wearing [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I armor]]. The officers commanded at [[Forward Command Center/Legends|Forward Command Centers]] and positions of great visual range. A handful of captains used [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]] to destroy the huge and clumsy [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy]] [[OG-9 homing spider droid/Legends|OG-9 homing spider droids]], throwing pulse grenades as they raced across the battlefield. Also, a branch of [[Clone jet trooper/Legends|jet trooper]] captains participated in many prominent battles, such as [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu's]] [[Battle of Dantooine (Clone Wars)|defense of Dantooine]]. Some time after first battle on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], clones began customizing their armor in various color schemes and patters. This carried on into the use of [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II armor]]. One notable clone captain was [[Rex/Legends|Rex]], who fought on the front lines with the grit of an [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]]. He participated in many campaigns throughout the war and was initially the senior clone officer of the elite [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] until [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|clone trooper sergeant]] [[Appo/Legends|Appo]] was promoted and became a [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone trooper commander]], taking over Rex's duties as the legion's commanding officer.
